name: Inwai Saimin Seitaiin ~Bitch na Onna o Seijun ni Jinkaku Henkan Massage~
original_name: 淫猥催眠整体院～ビッチな女を清純に 人格変換マッサージ～
source:
Tucked away in the back of a modest shopping district was an equally modest chiropractic clinic.
But this clinic had a secret.
Its director, Shioya Kazuhito, had a peculiar talent.
Under his hands, any woman—her body, her mind, even the deepest corners of her soul—would unravel completely.
Today, like every day, beautiful women visited the clinic, seeking the irresistible comfort of his "reconstruction."

"You’ve been carrying a lot of tension. Let’s release that now."

Amid the intoxicating blend of massage and aromatherapy, the director’s voice seeped into their minds.

"Feel that warmth flowing through you… Your chest, your lower back… it feels good, doesn’t it? So good. You’re melting, dissolving into pure bliss."

"And soon, you’ll take on a new form… A more captivating version of yourself, shaped exactly as I guide you…"

Yes, Shioya Kazuhito’s true skill was hypnosis.
The women, now like puppets in his hands, would sink into the depths of hypnotic ecstasy, utterly enchanted, utterly corrupted.
He reveled in this sinful craft, taking genuine pleasure in his work—until one day, a strange woman approached him.

"You a doctor? Wanna hang out? Treat me to something. Wanna get freaky? Sure, how much you offering?"

She was a hopeless, trashy, airheaded slut.
Getting involved with someone like her would be a waste of time.
But then, a thought struck him.
Up until now, he’d taken refined women like Tomoe Reiko and turned them into depraved creatures, turned chaste wives like Akagi Azusa into shameless exhibitionists.
What if… he tried the opposite?

今天，就像每一天一样，美丽的女人来到诊所，寻求他的“重建”带来的不可抗拒的安慰。

“你一直承受着很大的压力。现在让我们释放一下吧。”

在令人陶醉的按摩与香薰的交融中，导演的声音渗入了他们的脑海。

“感觉温暖流过你的身体……你的胸部，你的下背部……感觉很好，不是吗？太好了。你正在融化，融入纯粹的幸福之中。”

“很快，你就会呈现出一种新的形态……一个更迷人的自己，完全按照我的指导塑造……”

那些女人，现在就像他手中的木偶一样，会陷入催眠狂喜的深处，完全着迷，完全堕落。

“你是一名医生？想出去玩吗？请我吃点东西。想变得怪异吗？当然，你提供多少钱？”

她是一个绝望、无用、愚蠢的荡妇。

但随后，他突然想到了一个念头。
